test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

John's coffee is __hot__ than Jack's.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is making a **comparison between two things** – John’s coffee and Jack’s coffee.
 
• For comparisons between two entities, use the **comparative degree** of the adjective.
 
• The comparative form of "hot" is "**hotter**."
 
• Other options are incorrect: 
 
 
• **Most hot** – superlative form, used when comparing more than two.
 
• **More hotter** – incorrect due to **double comparatives** ("more" + "-er" form).
 
• **Hottest** – superlative degree, again used for comparing more than two.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"John's coffee is **hotter** than Jack's."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Use the **comparative form (-er)** when comparing two items (e.g., taller, faster, hotter).
 
• Use the **superlative form (-est)** for three or more items (e.g., tallest, fastest, hottest).
